'''Ayano Shibuya''' (Japanese: '''渋谷彩乃''' ''Shibuya Ayano'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Shibuya was born sometime on May 18, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She started work on {{aniseries|PTS}} with {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced {{an|Kiawe}}'s younger sister [[Mimo]]. She is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
